claims: The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray starts around $70,000.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is mid-engine.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray features a 6.2L LT2 V8 engine.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray delivers up to 495 horsepower.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray achieves 0–60 mph in 2.9 seconds with the Z51 package.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is available in coupe and convertible.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has 490 horsepower standard.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has 495 horsepower with performance exhaust.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has 465 lb-ft torque standard.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has 470 lb-ft torque with Z51.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission.
The C8 generation moved the engine to the rear.
